Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — it was helpful. Marta and I want to schedule a technical session focused on integrating our ingestion pipeline with Redwood's dedicated runtime. High level asks:
- Walkthrough of network topology / VPC peering patterns you recommend
- Expected token throughput for our batch job (approx 200 req/s daytime)

- Tue 2027-03-09 10:00–11:15
- Wed 2027-03-10 13:00–14:15

If none of these work, tell me two preferred windows and I'll adjust. I will also create a shared Drive folder for pre-reads and post the link.
